text: dsh-theme-linen 是面向 DSH Web 的暖中性界面主题，通过客户端 token 覆盖层调整页面底色、边框、侧栏、代码区和交互控件，并提供独立设置页。用户可切换暖色或产品配色，拖动滑块调整各级圆角与强调文字字重，也能填写正文字体和代码字体；亮色与暗色外观都使用对应 token。关闭主题会移除覆盖层。适合想为 Web 界面统一调整观感和字体的 DSH 用户；安装通过插件管理器指定本地 bundle 路径，代码未要求 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-theme-linen is a warm-neutral theme for DSH Web. It styles surfaces and controls for light and dark appearance. Settings tune palette, radius, text weight, and fonts. Disable it to remove overrides. Install from a local bundle path; no API key or external service is declared.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成暖一点的中性色调
能不能单独调节界面圆角和字体粗细？
I want to customize the colors and typography of the DSH web interface.
dsh-theme-linen 的暖色与产品配色设置：在设置页切换主题配色，客户端为亮色和暗色界面应用对应的背景、边框及控件 token；关闭主题可移除覆盖层。
dsh-theme-linen 的外观微调：设置页提供圆角和强调字重滑块，以及正文字体、代码字体输入；滑块拖动时预览，结束时保存设置。

dsh-theme-linen README · Linen theme：[](https://github.com/Chuyuxuan0v0/deepseek-harness-theme-linen/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

A warm neutral theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. It warms the surfaces, rounds the corners one step further, and prefers sharper default fonts — in both light and dark appearance.

DSH Web 界面的暖中性主题：表面更温暖、圆角再圆一档、默认字体更锐利，亮色与暗色外观同时生效。

dsh-theme-linen README · What it changes：| Area | Effect |
|---|---|
| Surfaces | Page, raised layers, overlay, sidebar, code blocks, and scrollbars move to a warm neutral palette |
| Borders and text | Four border steps and seven text steps retuned to the same warm ramp |
| Corner radius | A slider interpolates every tier between the product scale `4/8/12/16/20/28` and the roundest `12/20/26/34/40/52`; 100 on the slider equals the rounded scale earlier releases shipped |
| Fonts | Default text and code stacks prefer `system-ui` / `Cascadia Code`; emphasis drops from 600 to 500 |
| Interactive fills | Hover, active, ghost-button, and floating-button fills follow the warm ramp |

dsh-theme-linen README · What it deliberately does not change：- **Font sizes and line heights** — the theme presenter rewrites them from Settings on every apply, so an override would leave the font-size stepper in Settings doing nothing. Use Appearance → font size instead.
- **Elevation and shadow tokens** — declared on `body, body *`, so a body-level override never reaches the elements that consume them.
- **Menu material** — `--dsw-menu-surface-fill` and `--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter` are theme-owned; overriding them breaks the shared menu blur contract.
- **Product icons** — `ThemeDefinition.icons` exists only on `ctx.theme.register`, which would replace your light/dark preference.
- **Brand, link, and state colors** — a theme that recolors success, warning, error, or link stops communicating state.
section: What it deliberately does not change

text: dsh-theme-linen README · What it deliberately does not change：Circles, capsules, and hairline details keep their own literal geometry; only the shared `--dsw-radius-*` scale follows the theme.

dsh-theme-linen README · Install：The bundle is self-contained: no dependencies are installed at activation time (the schema library is vendored). Install it through the plugin manager with the absolute path to this directory:

```text
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute path to this directory>" }
```

Or from a packed tarball, extract it first and point `install_bundle` at the extracted directory.

Reload the window once after installing. The theme then applies immediately on every later load.
dsh-theme-linen README · Configure：Open **Settings → Linen theme**. Changes apply immediately and are stored in the Host settings document, so they survive a restart and follow you across browsers.

dsh-theme-linen README · Configure：| Setting | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Enable the Linen theme | on / off | Off restores every product default |
| Palette | Warm / Product | Product keeps the original colors and applies only corners and fonts |
| Corner radius | slider, 0–200 | Interpolates every radius tier: 0 is the product scale, 100 is the roundest scale earlier releases shipped, 200 is rounder still |
| Emphasis weight | slider, 300–700 | Weight of emphasized body text in steps of 100; product default is 600 |
| Body font | font list | Empty uses the theme stack; a font chosen in Appearance still wins |
| Code font | font list | Code blocks, inline code, and code text outside the terminal |

dsh-theme-linen README · Configure：Dragging a slider repaints immediately but writes to the Host only when the gesture ends, so a drag costs one settings write instead of one per pixel. Font fields take comma-separated family names and commit on blur or Enter.

dsh-theme-linen README · Requirements：- A DeepSeek Harness profile with the Web client (`dsh web` or the desktop app).
- The `theme`, `slots`, `configForms`, and `locale` client services, which the standard Web composition provides.

dsh-theme-linen README · Layout：```
index.js              Host half: the Config schema (all fields volatile)
client.js             Browser half: the token layer and the settings page
cordis.patch.yml      Bundle patch that inserts the plugin row
locale/*.json         Plugin manager title and description (8 languages)

dsh-theme-linen README · Releasing：Publishing is tag-driven and needs no configuration: no secrets, no local build step.

```sh
git tag v1.0.1
git push origin v1.0.1
```

The `Release` workflow then validates the package, builds the tarball, and attaches it to the GitHub Release, using the `GITHUB_TOKEN` GitHub provides automatically. Pushing a tag that already has a release replaces the attached asset instead of failing.

Before tagging, the same checks run on every push and pull request, and locally:

dsh-theme-linen README · Releasing：```sh
npm pack --dry-run --json > /tmp/pack.json && node scripts/verify.mjs /tmp/pack.json
```

`scripts/verify.mjs` guards the invariants that would otherwise break silently: the browser module id must equal the package name, the settings namespace must equal the patch row id, every `Config` field must be `.volatile()`, the vendored schema library must resolve from the packed files, and every locale must carry a title and description.

dsh-theme-linen README · Notes for theme authors：- Every token value is a `{ light, dark }` pair. The theme service rejects a bare string on purpose: a single value goes illegible when the color scheme flips.
- The layer is applied through `overrideTokens`, so the Appearance preference keeps working and the theme never appears as a fourth choice.
- Settings fields must be `.volatile()`. The settings directory only exposes a namespace when at least one field is live, and a token change must apply without remounting the browser plugin.
dsh-theme-linen README · License：MIT for this plugin. The vendored `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` and `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` builds retain their own MIT licenses, shipped alongside in `vendor/`. ---
dsh-theme-linen README · 中文：一个暖中性主题。它让界面表面更温暖、圆角再圆一档、默认字体更锐利，亮色和暗色外观同时生效。
dsh-theme-linen README · 改了什么：页面与浮层底色、四级边框、七级文字色阶、侧栏、代码块与行内代码、滚动条、插画、悬停与激活填充，统一挪到暖中性色阶；圆角用滑块在「产品尺度 ↔ 最圆」之间连续调整；正文字体和代码字体优先使用 `system-ui` 与 `Cascadia Code`；加粗正文默认 500。

dsh-theme-linen README · 刻意不改什么：字号与行高（会被设置里的字号控件覆盖，改了那个控件就成了摆设）、elevation 与阴影（在 `body, body *` 上逐元素声明，body 级覆盖到不了）、菜单材质（主题所有权，覆盖会破坏共享毛玻璃）、产品图标（只在 `register` 上，会顶掉你的亮暗偏好）、品牌色与状态色（改了就不再传达状态）。

圆圈、胶囊和发丝级细节保持自己的字面量几何，只有共享的 `--dsw-radius-*` 尺度跟随主题。

dsh-theme-linen README · 安装：这个包是自包含的，激活时不装任何依赖（schema 库已随包携带）。用插件管理器指向本目录的绝对路径安装：

```text
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<本目录绝对路径>" }
```

安装后刷新一次窗口。之后每次加载都会自动生效。
dsh-theme-linen README · 更新：`install_bundle` 不允许重复安装同一个包，先移除再装，然后重启 `dsh` 让浏览器加载新的模块。

dsh-theme-linen README · 发版：推标签即可，不需要任何额外配置（不用配 secret，也不用本地打包）：

```sh
git tag v1.0.1
git push origin v1.0.1
```

`Release` 工作流会自动校验、打包并把 tgz 挂到对应 Release 上，用的是 GitHub 自带的 `GITHUB_TOKEN`。同一个标签重跑会替换附件而不是报错。

推之前同样的检查也会在每次 push 和 PR 上跑，本地也可以跑：

```sh
npm pack --dry-run --json > /tmp/pack.json && node scripts/verify.mjs /tmp/pack.json
```

dsh-theme-linen README · 配置：打开 **设置 → 亚麻主题**。改动立即生效，保存在宿主设置文档里，重启后仍在，换浏览器也跟随。可调：启用开关、配色（暖中性 / 产品原色）、圆角滑块（0–200，0 是产品尺度，100 等于旧版的「圆润」，200 更圆）、强调字重滑块（300–700，以 100 为步进）、正文字体、代码字体。

拖动滑块时画面立即跟手，但只在松手时才写入宿主，所以一次拖动只产生一次设置写入，而不是每个像素一次。

字体输入框接受逗号分隔的字体名，失焦或回车提交；留空则使用主题自带的字体栈，而你在「外观」里手选的字体始终优先。
